run_my_app: run the Hydra app that instantiates an Optimizer, Dataset, and Trainer from config
instantiate_optimizer: instantiate an Optimizer object from a Hydra config node with algo and lr parameters
instantiate_optimizer_override_lr: instantiate an Optimizer from config and override the lr parameter at the call site
instantiate_trainer_recursive: recursively instantiate a Trainer with nested Optimizer and Dataset from a Hydra config
instantiate_trainer_override_nested: instantiate a Trainer from config and override nested optimizer and dataset parameters at the call site
